text:
I understand you'd like to cancel your Leafy Plus membership. Unfortunately, I can't issue a refund in this case.

**Here's why:** Leafy Plus refunds are only available if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase **and** haven't used any benefits. Since you've already used free shipping (a member benefit) and it's now 20 days since purchase, the 14-day refund window has closed. Your membership remains active through the end of the paid year, and the benefits continue.

**However, you can still cancel** from "Account" > "Subscriptions" anytime—you'll just keep your benefits until your membership expires. Would you like me to escalate this to a Support Lead to review your situation further?
